description: Satellite imagery of a coastal area, likely in false-colour infrared, illustrating the delineation between "8.4.2.0 Coastal waters" and "8.4.1.0 Open sea". The land, visible in the upper portion of the image, displays urban areas (grey/blue) and vegetated land (red). The immediate coastal water is light blue/green, transitioning to dark blue/black for deeper offshore areas. A vertical orange arrow originating from the coastline extends seaward to a yellow irregular line, which marks the boundary between the two water classifications. This arrow is labelled "= 1 nautical mile", indicating that "Coastal waters" are defined as the area extending up to one nautical mile from the landside, with "Open sea" starting beyond this boundary. No specific geographic location or date is provided in the image.
